rca of the issue: request-revision 500 RCA: routes/portal.py:1472-1484 executes db.wrap_data.update_one with $push: {'design.revision_notes': revision_note}. MongoDB rejects this with WriteError code 2 because wrap_data.design.revision_notes is stored as a string (legacy field) on existing docs. Reproduction: POST /api/portal/orders/118b7377-687b-4a28-b42b-3c5f31da64c5/wrap/aa0387f8-ac70-4935-9bbc-33d03963e916/request-revision with body {notes:'x'} as authenticated portal customer → 500 + backend log shows the pymongo WriteError. Mitigation options: (a) one-time migration: db.wrap_data.updateMany({'design.revision_notes': {'$type':'string'}}, [{'$set': {'design.revision_notes': []}}]); (b) in-handler coercion via an aggregation-pipeline update; (c) read-modify-write inside the endpoint (load doc, normalize, $set the whole array). Option (a) is cleanest. All other 5 portal actions tested OK — bug is isolated to this single endpoint.
